recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any future changes to implementationguide-sourceFile should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack, not by reintroducing the extension definition into core.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 issue asked for a standard 0..* sourceFile extension on ImplementationGuide.definition to identify publication files other than definition.resource entries, with file Reference, location string, and keepAsResource boolean components.
initial_application: Core commit 81f7c6c5f5 added the implementationguide-sourceFile StructureDefinition and referenced it from the core ImplementationGuide profile. Core later retained the OID mapping in source/oids.ini, while commit dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source as part of relocating them out of core.
additional_context: The current core source still has ImplementationGuide as an active resource and retains the implementationguide-sourceFile OID mapping, but the extension definition itself is present in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/ImplementationGuide/StructureDefinition-implementationguide-sourceFile.xml. Later FHIR-46629 corrected the extension component fixedUri values in the Extension Pack, confirming subsequent maintenance belongs there. FHIR-24649 is related background for page.source[x], but it is a separate R5 ImplementationGuide tracker.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no core source change. Re-adding the extension StructureDefinition to core would reverse the intentional extension-pack relocation; the current authoritative source for this request is outside the core checkout.
